reviewNotes: Reviewed all 138 exported speech keys against all 20 active source cards and explicit furigana in data/pages47-49-physics-v2.json, as referenced by the catalog. Checked contextual topic は → わ, directional へ → え, object を → お. Preserved lexical 刃 は, はめん, はさき, はばひろ, はいる, はじめ, はたらき, はもと, はせん, はわたり, はこ and はなせます; preserved lexical へこみ, へいめん, へんけい. Checked りょうば, かたば, うらすき, うらおし, はまぐりば, とつめん, おうとつ, くさび, けんさくけいじょう, きょくしょてき, まげかじゅう and まげおうりょく against source. Loanwords rendered in hiragana with punctuation and long vowels preserved; terminal punctuation supplied. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
